title: 第23章 一记耳光第24章 熊玉
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
“当然带来了！”秦伏天手中出现了一卷红纸。
“好！”姜云岚点头，“秦伏天，记得你说的话。这次若是不能通过天剑门的弟子考核，你自己对所有人说清楚。从此以后，你我之间再无任何瓜葛。”
姜云岚眼中有着难掩的嫌恶。
似乎巴不得和秦伏天彻底划清关系。
秦伏天冷然一笑，摇了摇头，眼中同样有着冷蔑。
而此时，秦伏天和姜云岚的直接对话，却是在人群之中掀起轩然大波。
“你们听说了没有？这次秦伏天和姜云岚之间的赌约……据说如果秦伏天通过天剑门的弟子考核，哪怕是杂役弟子，他们的婚约依旧作数。”
“这么说，如果没有通过的话，婚约就作废了？”
“是这样子……我是从姜家听到的确切消息。”
众人纷纷议论，显然这些消息极有可能是姜震山故意放出，让外人知道。
“秦伏天丹田都已经破碎了，怎么可能通过考核？”
“所以，这是姜家给他摆了一道啊，明知他无法通过考核，却立下这样的赌约。如果秦伏天在这次考核当中失败，他人只会说他秦伏天无用，而不会说姜家翻脸无情。”
“我如果是秦伏天，就不会来这里。人贵有自知之明，秦伏天若是强行参加考核，最后只会颜面尽失，连最后的一丝尊严都被碾压……”
……
另外一边，山坡上的众多家族，此时也都在议论此事。
“秦家主，事到如今，秦伏天出现在这里，难道他真打算参加天剑门考核？”旁边柳氏家主出言问道。
秦天雄双眼微眯，旋即摇了摇头：“秦伏天之事，和我秦家已经没有关系！此子已经被我秦家逐出了家门，从今以后和我秦家再无瓜葛！”
此时秦天雄心中诧异，他也没有想到，秦伏天竟然会出现在这里。
明明秦天成已经去了黑风山脉，难道秦天成没有找到秦伏天？
“倒也是有这种可能，毕竟黑风山脉这么大，秦天成没有找到他也在情理之中……”

秦天雄自然无法相信，秦天成已经毙命在秦伏天的手里。
……
“好了，你是否要报名？”
而此时，元洪的目光也是落在秦伏天的身上，他有些不耐烦地开口：“若不报名，现在就离开这里。”
“我家少爷来这里，当然是要报名了！”秦青瑶连忙说道。
“报上你的家族，所属城池，以及你的姓名！”元洪冷声道。
“秦伏天，没有家族，孤家寡人一个！”秦伏天淡淡说道。
元洪将秦伏天的名字记录在册，表情更显得不耐烦，因为姜云岚的缘故，他自然是知道秦伏天的。
一个丹田破碎的废物，也想通过天剑门的考核？
这简直就是痴人说梦。
所以在元洪看来，这秦伏天更大的可能是来捣乱的。
“进傀儡山谷！”元洪令声道。
“少爷，加油！”
秦青瑶粉拳紧握，给秦伏天加油鼓劲。
秦伏天淡淡一笑，迈步走入傀儡山谷。
所有的目光在这一刻，皆是汇聚在秦伏天的身上。
有唏嘘，有感慨，更多的是等着看好戏的幸灾乐祸。
然而下一刻，秦伏天已是迈步而出。
他的步伐看似并不快，但一步迈出，却是出了十丈开外……
接着，山谷之中，连续出现了几个秦伏天的身影，当原来的身影消失之时，新的身影便是再次出现，不到二十息的时间，秦伏天竟然已经饶过一具具傀儡，完成了接近一半的路程！

后半程的困难更大，有两具相当于气海境武师的傀儡。
content_en:
"Of course I brought it!" A roll of red paper appeared in Qin Futian's hand.
"Okay!" Jiang Yunlan nodded, "Qin Futian, remember what you said. If you fail to pass the disciple test of Tianjian Sect this time, you must make it clear to everyone. From now on, there will be no relationship between you and me."
There was unconcealable disgust in Jiang Yunlan's eyes.
It seems that he is eager to completely separate his relationship with Qin Futian.
Qin Futian smiled coldly and shook his head, with the same cold contempt in his eyes.
At this time, the direct conversation between Qin Futian and Jiang Yunlan caused an uproar among the crowd.
"Have you heard about this bet between Qin Futian and Jiang Yunlan... It is said that if Qin Futian passes the disciple assessment of Tianjian Sect, even if he is a handyman disciple, their engagement will still count."
"So, if it doesn't pass, the engagement will be void?"
"That's it...I heard the exact news from the Jiang family."
Everyone was talking, and it was obvious that Jiang Zhenshan had most likely deliberately released this information to let outsiders know.
"Qin Futian's dantian has been shattered, how can he pass the test?"
"So, this is a trick that the Jiang family set up for him. They knew that he could not pass the test, but they made such a bet. If Qin Futian fails in this test, others will only say that Qin Futian is useless, but they will not say that the Jiang family is ruthless."
"If I were Qin Futian, I wouldn't come here. People should be self-aware. If Qin Futian forced himself to take the assessment, he would only lose face in the end, and even his last shred of dignity would be crushed..."
…
On the other side, many families on the hillside were also discussing this matter.
"Master Qin, now that Qin Futian has appeared here, does he really intend to take part in the Tianjian Sect's assessment?" The head of the Liu family next to him asked.
Qin Tianxiong narrowed his eyes slightly and immediately shook his head: "Qin Futian's matter has nothing to do with my Qin family! This son has been expelled from our Qin family and has nothing to do with my Qin family from now on!"
At this time, Qin Tianxiong was surprised. He did not expect that Qin Futian would appear here.
Qin Tiancheng has obviously gone to the Black Wind Mountains. Didn't Qin Tiancheng find Qin Futian?
"It is possible. After all, the Black Wind Mountain Range is so big, it makes sense that Qin Tiancheng didn't find him..."
Qin Tianxiong naturally couldn't believe that Qin Tiancheng had died in Qin Futian's hands.
…
"Okay, do you want to sign up?"
At this time, Yuan Hong's eyes also fell on Qin Futian, and he said impatiently: "If you don't sign up, leave here now."
"My young master is here, of course he has to sign up!" Qin Qingyao said quickly.
"Tell me your family, the city you belong to, and your name!" Yuan Hong said coldly.
"Qin Futian, he has no family and is alone!" Qin Futian said lightly.
Yuan Hong recorded Qin Futian's name in the book, his expression even more impatient. Because of Jiang Yunlan, he naturally knew Qin Futian.
A waste with a broken Dantian also wants to pass the test of Tianjian Sect?
This is simply nonsense.
Therefore, in Yuan Hong's opinion, Qin Futian was more likely to come to cause trouble.
"Enter the Puppet Valley!" Yuan Hongling said.
"Master, come on!"
Qin Qingyao clenched her fists tightly, cheering Qin Futian on.
Qin Futian smiled lightly and walked into the Puppet Valley.
At this moment, all eyes were focused on Qin Futian.
There are sighs, emotions, and more of a schadenfreude waiting to see a good show.
However, the next moment, Qin Futian stepped out.
His steps don't seem to be fast, but when he takes one step, he travels ten feet away...
Then, several figures of Qin Futian appeared in the valley one after another. When the original figures disappeared, new figures appeared again. In less than twenty breaths, Qin Futian had spared each puppet, completely.It’s nearly half the journey!
The second half was even more difficult, as there were two puppets equivalent to Qi Hai realm martial artists.
